how: Sky Safari Emirates sells tandem paragliding flights over the Al Faya desert in Sharjah emirate, not at a Dubai site.
Gravity Zone in Meydan was reported as the first permanent bungee platform in the Middle East, with jumps up to about 160 ft; the reports are old, so current operation should be checked.
JA Shooting Club at JA The Resort has five floodlit clay ranges (trap, skeet, sporting) open to non-members with ID, from age 13.

Only rare whale and whale-shark sightings off Dubai (humpback 2017, orcas 2022); no whale-watching tours found, nearest organised marine-wildlife cruises are in Musandam (Oman), roughly 3 hours by road.
